text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(I can still go, I can go faster!
Don't stop your legs! Keep running!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that girl was super fast!
Calstone Light O.
She was totally different from everyone else!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I get it, like a sudden surge.
It felt like she was piercing right through.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O's running
was already catching the eye of some spectators.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Good work, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes, quick outfit changes are my specialty.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I accidentally put my undershirt on backwards, so it feels a bit awkward.
choice_data_list: No, you should really change out of that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I told her that she didn't need to rush so much next time, and had her change clothes properly for now.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how was the speed?
The instantaneous top speed. You were measuring it, right?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Somehow, I was able to build up speed quite effortlessly.
I feel confident I was faster than usual."
choice_data_list: About 67 km/h. That's faster than average!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I suppose that earns a passing grade.
It felt like a better run than the mock race, at least.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Most likely, this is the result of correcting her form.
Her cornering, which was her main weakness, was considerably more stable than before.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I see, things are going smoother than anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Then let's breeze through this quickly. Next stop, GⅠ!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The pace develops as fast as ever.
However... with her speed, standing at the very top
of her generation of Umamusume wouldn't be impossible.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's take on a GⅠ race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When it comes to Junior Class GⅠ races, there's the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hanshin Racecourse, 1600 meters—
it's certainly not an impossible distance for her.
The course is right-handed as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And at the Asahi Hai FS, the fleetest of the Junior Class will surely gather."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great. Let's aim for top speed there.
I'm entering the Asahi Hai FS!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our next target has been decided.
First, we need to adapt to the extra 400 meters of distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A new regimen of training days begins
in preparation for the Asahi Hai FS.
